text:
sasha: FYI the midnight model-poller cron (model-poller-v2) failed and the nightly bench didn't run. noticed on the dashboard at ~00:12 UTC :eyes:

sasha: logs show a bunch of 503s from storage during shard download, then the job exited with non-zero: 
```
2026-03-17T00:11:58Z ERROR fetch_shard s3://models/redwood/v2/xx shard=34 status=503
2026-03-17T00:12:03Z WARN retrying fetch_shard attempt=3
2026-03-17T00:12:09Z ERROR poller main failed: download_shard: last_err=503 ServiceUnavailable
```

sasha: opening this thread bc CI is red for the nightly bench and I don't want a full rerun until we triage a bit. can someone from infra/eng-ml take a quick look?

matt: thanks for flagging. can you paste the job id? also are there other buckets hitting S3 errors?

sasha: job id is `cron-2026-03-17T00-10Z:model-poller-v2:run-87`

sasha: quick grep shows same error across 7 shard fetches in a row, all ~00:11-00:12 UTC. other jobs around same time (e.g., kvcache janitor) had a couple transient 5xxs but recovered.

priya: could be transient S3 throttling in the eu-west region. we've seen a spike in multipart requests earlier. if it's region-level, retry/backoff should handle it but the poller might be hitting tight timeout bounds.

matt: can we rerun just the poller job (not the whole nightly bench) to see if it was transient? jen can you kick a rerun when free? command is `infra cron rerun --job-id cron-2026-03-17T00-10Z:model-poller-v2:run-87`

jen: on it, pinging deploy-bot...

ci-bot: Rerun request received for cron-2026-03-17T00-10Z:model-poller-v2:run-87. queued on infra-runner-3. ETA ~2m. :gear:

jen: rerun started, I'll post results in a few

ci-bot: Rerun completed: FAILURE. exit_code=1. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/cron-2026-03-17T00-10Z/run-87/retry-1

matt: dang. same 503s? anyone able to share the exact stacktrace from the retry run?

sasha: pasted snippet from retry logs: 
```
2026-03-17T00:14:02Z ERROR fetch_shard s3://models/redwood/v2/xx shard=34 status=503
2026-03-17T00:14:08Z ERROR fetch_shard s3://models/redwood/v2/xx shard=35 status=503
2026-03-17T00:14:12Z ERROR poller main failed: download_shard: last_err=503 ServiceUnavailable
```

sasha: it's consistently failing on a contiguous shard range (34-40) which is odd. could be a bad object or a bad node in the storage tier.

priya: if it's contiguous shards, maybe a bad upload / checksum mismatch or partial object. can we try a `s3 md5` or `head-object` for one of the failing keys? also check any recent model-sync uploads at ~23:50 that might've been interrupted.

matt: good call. sasha, can you run `aws s3api head-object --bucket models --key redwood/v2/xx/shard-34` and paste headers (ETag, content-length)?

sasha: ran head-object: ETag="d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e", content-length=0, last-modified=2026-03-17T00:00:12Z

sasha: content-length 0 :grimacing:

priya: ah that explains the 503s — looks like a zero-byte object somehow. probably upload failed but metadata remained. that will cause our fetch to choke.

matt: ok that's actionable. two follow-ups: 1) replace the zero-byte shards from last successful artifact (we have artifacts in gcs://artifacts/model-sync/2026-03-16T23-45), 2) add a guard in poller to treat zero-byte shards as retryable + alert to model-sync owner.

sasha: i'll restore shard-34..40 from the artifact tarball now and kick the poller rerun. doing `gsutil cp gs://artifacts/model-sync/2026-03-16T23-45/shard-34 ./ && aws s3 cp shard-34 s3://models/redwood/v2/xx/shard-34 --acl private`

jen: let me know when you push, i'll rerun once uploaded.

sasha: restored and re-uploaded 34..40. checksum matches artifact. pushed at 00:23 UTC.

ci-bot: Manual rerun requested by jen for job cron-2026-03-17T00-10Z:model-poller-v2:run-87. queued.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: SUCCESS. poller finished, updated model catalog, and nightly bench scheduled.

matt: awesome. can you open a quick follow-up issue to add the zero-byte guard and a model-sync post-check? tag @priya for storage/ops context.

sasha: opened issue #2412: "model-poller: treat zero-byte shard as failed upload and alert model-sync". assigned to matt.

priya: I'll add a short runbook note about verifying artifact completeness and add a small retry/backoff bump in the uploader.

jen: thanks y'all — closing the red CI alert. :white_check_mark:

matt: moving to postmortem-lite: root cause = partial upload left zero-byte shards; mitigations = artifact validation + poller guard + uploader retry. planning doc incoming.

sasha: thanks for the quick triage everyone :heart:
